Ko za ku buɗe asusu a nan shawararku ce, kuma aikin ba ya ɗaukar wani alhaki a kai. <where>Inda ake ajiye asusunku, da zaɓinku</where>

mfa.heading: Shiga mataki biyu
mfa.intro: Nemi mataki na biyu idan kun shiga, ban da kalmar sirrinku: lamba daga manhajar authenticator, ko passkey. Sannan wanda ya san kalmar sirrinku har yanzu ba zai iya shiga ba.
mfa.loadFailed: Ba a iya loda shiga mataki biyunku ba. Don Allah ku sake loda shafin.
mfa.onText: Kuna shiga da kalmar sirrinku da mataki na biyu, ko da passkey shi kaɗai.
mfa.off: Shiga mataki biyu a kashe yake.
mfa.offText: Don kunna shi, saita manhajar authenticator ko ku ƙara passkey.
mfa.confirmEmailFirst: Tabbatar da imel ɗinku da farko, a sama. Muna amfani da shi don sanar da ku canje-canje ga yadda kuke shiga, da kuma taimakawa idan kun rasa mataki na biyunku.
mfa.appText: Manhaja a wayarku ko a manajan kalmomin sirrinku tana nuna sabuwar lamba kowane daƙiƙa 30, don ku shigar da ita idan kun shiga.

mfa.passkeysText: Passkey yana shigar da ku da hoton yatsanku, fuskarku ko kulle allo, a wannan na'ura ko wayarku. Zai iya zama mataki na biyunku, ko ya shigar da ku shi kaɗai, ba tare da kalmar sirrinku ba.

mfa.offWhat: Shiga mataki biyu yana kasancewa a kunne muddin kuna da manhajar authenticator ko passkey. Cire na ƙarshe daga cikinsu yana kashe shi, sannan:

export.heading: Sauke bayanaina
export.text: Ajiye kwafin duk abin da asusunku ke ɗauke da shi a matsayin fayil ɗaya: bayananku, saituna, kayan da kuke da su, girke-girke, kayan aiki, kayan ƙari, rubuce-rubuce, bayanan gasa, shawarwari da kwandon shara. Bai ƙunshi kalmar sirrinku ba. Ajiye fayil ɗin a wuri na sirri, domin yana ɗauke da duk abin da kuka ajiye.
export.csvText: Ko ku ajiye spreadsheet na girke-girkenku kawai ko kayanku kawai, don buɗewa a Excel, Numbers ko Sheets.

trash.heading: Kwandon shara
trash.text: Abin da kuka cire daga littafin aikinku yana jira a Kwandon shara na kwana 30. Dawo da shi daga can, ko ku share shi har abada.

shared.heading: Girke-girken da aka raba

shared.fetchFailed: Ba a iya loda girke-girkenku da aka raba ba. Don Allah a sake gwadawa.

lead.help: Darma (Pb) guba ce idan aka shaƙa ko aka haɗiye ta kuma tana taruwa a jiki, kuma glaze mai darma zai iya sakin ta cikin abinci da abin sha; babu lissafin da zai iya faɗin ko tukunyar da aka gasa tana yi. A kashe, girke-girken da suke da darma tuni har yanzu suna buɗewa yadda suke.
lead.warning: Yi amfani da darma (Pb) a matsayin frit kawai, kada a taɓa amfani da ita a matsayin ɗanyar darma ja, fara ko rawaya ko litharge. Haɗa ta da ruwa, kada a taɓa fesa ta, sa respirator kuma ku tsaftace da ruwa. Ajiye tukwane masu glaze na darma nesa da abinci da abin sha sai dai idan gwajin zubar ƙarfe (leach test) na dakin gwaji kan tukunyar da aka gasa ya yi nasara.

providers.heading: Google, GitHub da Microsoft
providers.intro: Haɗa asusun Google, GitHub ko Microsoft don shiga da shi. Glazecalc yana ajiye id na asusun kawai daga gare shi, ba a taɓa ajiye sunansa, hotonsa ko wani abu dabam ba, kuma shiga mataki biyu har yanzu yana neman mataki na biyunsa.

confirm.heading: Tabbatar kafin canje-canje
confirm.intro: Zaɓi ko canji daga mataimaki, manhaja ko access token zai jira har sai kun amince da shi a nan, bayan kun shiga. Babu abin da ya nema da za a canza har sai kun yi.
confirm.offHint: Ana yin canje-canje nan take. Kowanne yana ajiye bayanin kamar yadda yake, don ku iya soke shi, kuma ana nuna abin da kowace manhaja ta yi a ƙasa.
confirm.removalsHintSite: Mayar da bayani zuwa Kwandon shara, cire kaya daga kayan da kuke da su, ko cire bayanan gasa daga girke-girke yana jiran amincewarku a wannan shafin yanar gizo.
confirm.allHint: Kowane sabon bayani, canji, soke canji da cirewa yana jiran amincewarku a wannan shafin yanar gizo.
confirm.how: Canjin da ke jira yana da shafinsa, wanda mataimaki ko rubutun kwamfuta ke ba ku mahaɗinsa. Yana jira minti 30, sannan ba a canza komai. Access token da aka yi da "Canje-canje daga wannan token ba sa buƙatar tabbatarwa" ba a taɓa tambayarsa.
confirm.saveFailed: Kuskure: ba a iya ajiye zaɓinku ba. Don Allah a sake gwadawa.

tokens.heading: Access token
tokens.intro: Access token yana bar mataimakin AI ɗinku ko rubutun kwamfutarku ya karanta girke-girke, kayan aiki, rubuce-rubuce da bayanan gasa a asusunku, kuma, idan kun zaɓa, ya canza su. Kowane token yana daina aiki a ranar da kuka zaɓa, ko da zarar kun soke shi.
tokens.seeThem: Token ɗinku da manhajojin da aka haɗa, abin da kowanne ya yi, da Soke suna shafin Manhajojin da aka haɗa.

tokens.confirmEmailFirst: Kafin ku iya yin token, ku tabbatar da imel ɗinku: buɗe mahaɗin da muka aika zuwa {email}. Muna sanar da ku a wannan adireshi idan aka yi token da kafin ɗaya ya daina aiki.
tokens.scopeNote: Token ɗin zai iya karanta bayananku amma ba zai canza su ba.
tokens.scopeWriteNote: Token ɗin zai kuma iya ajiye sababbin bayanai, canza su da mayar da su zuwa Kwandon shara. Kowane canji yana ajiye bayanin kamar yadda yake, don ku iya soke shi, kuma abin da token ɗin ya yi yana a Manhajojin da aka haɗa da cikin Sauke bayanaina. Zaɓi wannan ne kawai don mataimaki ko rubutun kwamfuta da kuka amince ya canza bayananku.
tokens.confirmStep: Don yin token ɗin, ku tabbatar cewa ku ne.
